purpose: First independent larger-basis relative-energy test of the variable-sector physical tensor family
initialization: One CUDA integral/RHF preparation per new geometry, full basis, pure singlet determinant; no correlated density, label or fitted parameter
capacity: One a priori 128-state spin-complete bound for the changed family; no rank/seed/iteration campaign and no change after chemical reference inspection
truncation: Spin-complete physical Schmidt retraction; reject energy-increasing candidates, retain every rejection and use the original stopping/audit
reference_use: Both predictions and frozen common-context audits finish before either reference. If either prediction fails its gate, do not spend a reference campaign on this protocol. Independent six-particle singlet-projected CUDA reference action starts from its own determinant only afterward.
scope: Two new full cc-pVDZ finite-basis predictions and one balanced stretch contrast; development evidence, not CBS/GMTKN55, WTMAD-2, an arbitrary-density XC model or proof of broad generalization
resource_limit: One CUDA job and one host core; at most 1 GB new disk inside 32 GB working/40 GB total; no CPU scientific fallback
